messages:
elaine_pm: FYI customer asks: must approve any model swap for their dedicated clusters and receive a 72h notice. They want an auditable consent flow and a visible tenant toggle in Console. Can we map this into a rollout playbook?

sam_eng: short answer: yes. We need (1) tenant opt-in state stored in EU KMS if tenant is EU, (2) schedule API + UI, (3) per-tenant canary windows + sticky assignment.

dmitri_sre: Ops constraints: every cutover needs a pre-window health check (30m baseline), active watch 1h post cutover, and automated fallback on severe signals. Propose automated soft-fallback then manual rollback if alerts persist.

jia_prodops: scheduling flow suggestion: customer signs consent -> legal-bot logs consent event -> prodops approves window in Console -> on agreed window, scheduler triggers warm-up tasks and notifies SRE.

legal-bot: Consent recorded: tenant=ACME-EU, consent_ts=2026-03-20T09:12:03Z, doc_ref=confluence/consent/acme-eu. (automated)

elaine_pm: We should publish a short customer-facing template for the consent email so Sales/CS don't improvise. Draft below: 
"Hi <customer>, confirm you approve the planned model cutover for your dedicated cluster. We will provide 72 hours notice and run a 1h monitored window. If you prefer a different window, reply with date/time. Reply YES to consent"

sam_eng: Implementation note: API shape for scheduling can be tiny — example: 
```
POST /v1/tenants/{id}/cutover
{ "requested_window_start": "2026-03-25T22:00:00Z", "consent_doc": "url" }
```
We return a scheduled_id and require prodops approval step.

dmitri_sre: Monitoring thresholds proposal: baseline p95 and error-rate measured for 30m pre-cutover; enforce auto SOFT_FALLBACK if p95 > baseline*1.6 for 3m; auto HARD_FALLBACK if errors > 3% for 3m or p95 > baseline*2 for 2m. Manual rollback if customer reports functional regressions.

jia_prodops: Additions: create calendar automation that attaches runbook and oncall rota to the scheduled window. Also add customer banner in Console when a cutover is imminent.

elaine_pm: Risk note: some customers want the toggle visible to their admins. We can add a tenant-admin-only toggle but gate it behind a signed consent to avoid accidental flips.

sam_eng: security: toggles mutate tenant state; require audit log and 2-person approval for private/dedicated. We'll add an "approve_cutover" action that records approver id.

legal-bot: Reminder: for EU tenants, audit logs and consent docs must be kept in EU region for 7 years per contract.

dmitri_sre: Runbook outline I'll draft: steps for pre-check, warm-up commands, smoke tests, rollback commands, post-mortem hooks. Will include automated commands we can paste into PagerDuty.

jia_prodops: Ops checklist items: verify consent doc -> schedule window -> prodops approval -> warm pool spin-up 30m before -> smoke tests pass -> flip flag -> 1h watch -> escalations if needed.

elaine_pm: Decision summary: 1) require documented consent for dedicated/private cutovers, 2) implement schedule API + tenant-admin toggle (UI), 3) enforce EU-local audit logging for EU tenants, 4) set automated thresholds for SOFT/HARD fallback per dmitri's proposal, 5) prodops owns scheduling and calendar automation.

sam_eng: I'll open a lightweight spec PR with UI mock and API stub. ETA: 2 sprints.

dmitri_sre: I'll post the runbook draft and the exact metrics math.

jia_prodops: I'll create the customer email template and calendar automation tasks.

elaine_pm: Thanks all. I'll notify the CS lead and sync with Sales to use the template. Follow-up in the spec PR and the runbook thread. :white_check_mark:
